wave c1 (LB-Q-otel-collector, 2026-10-09): acceptance is otelcol-contrib 0.162.0 validate (darwin_arm64 release, sha256 d5e11974d2e4adac3cc001a25137aad52f6e77ec3034ba7735cac7c219a5f97a), every ${env:...} given a placeholder; 8 of 10 candidate files accepted, 2 alone-and-as-a-layer over their base (opentelemetry-demo's otelcol-config-observability.yml and otelcol-config-full.yml), with three host-only error kinds disclosed and not counted (host_metrics root_path is Linux-only, a file_storage directory must exist, the service.profilesSupport feature gate); refused: opentelemetry-demo's otelcol-ebpf-profiling.yml (a profiling-distribution receiver the contrib collector does not carry) and collector-contrib's couchbase example (an OTTL function the collector no longer has), left out by -only. Definitions and references are the collector's own confmap decode into component.ID and pipeline.ID (tier A); the route pairs (exporter endpoint to the compose service its host names) are tier C, so L3 reads good: opentelemetry-demo's 4 exporters (jaeger, prometheus, opensearch, firepit) join the compose services of compose.observability.yaml and compose.profiling.yaml through the late-YAML dispatch (LB-F309); collector-contrib's 3 exporter endpoints are IP literals. The TelemetryIdentity and OtelDerivedMetric kinds are out of oracle_kinds (excluded_by_kind): rules read off the TL-5 contract and the connectors' source, not the collector's decode; the oracle's tier-C -rules-out lists the same 2 derived families on opentelemetry-demo (traces.span.metrics.calls and .duration, its span_metrics connector) and no identity in either subject, so identities are proven on fixtures only (otelcollector_dialect_test.go)
